remarks: Cute 1BR/1BA apartment occupying the 1st floor of a duplex, ideally located in Springdale, one of Stamford's most convenient and quiet residential neighborhoods. Eat-in kitchen with dishwasher, full bathroom with tub, and exclusive basement access offers dry storage space and washer/ dryer. Parking is a standout feature with a dedicated off-street parking lot plus abundant on-street parking. Peaceful setting while remaining close to shopping, dining, Metro-North, and major commuting routes.
